definition.specificationDescription: Impulse learning data (impulse ID, turn context, pattern extracted, response quality) must be stored in SurrealDB via rpc-api endpoints
definition.expectedBehavior: POST /v1/learning/impulse-mappings accepts {impulse_id, turn_context, messages, response_quality} and stores in SurrealDB table impulse_learning_records. Implements pattern extraction logic from removed opencode/impulse-learning.ts

components.currentBehavior: Creates session-scoped in-memory buffer for data collection during turn execution
components.desiredBehavior: Same as current, but needs concurrency protection
components.gap: Race condition risk - no mutex/locking for concurrent turns on same session

components.currentBehavior: Stores intent analysis result in buffer without transformation
Strips impulse content (keeps only metadata) and stores in buffer
components.desiredBehavior: Current behavior is correct - reduces payload by 90%
components.gap: None - data minimization working as designed

components.currentBehavior: Validates buffer completeness, calls HTTP endpoint, fire-and-forget (no retry)
components.desiredBehavior: Add timeout, retry mechanism, and better error logging
components.gap: Silent failures on network issues, no timeout, no retry, incomplete buffers deleted without notification
components.priority: HIGH - blocks production (timeout), MEDIUM - acceptable for MVP (retry)

components.currentBehavior: HTTP POST to /api/v1/learning-loop/record-turn with no timeout, no retry, no authentication
components.desiredBehavior: Add AbortController with 30s timeout, optionally add retry with exponential backoff
components.gap: No timeout (can hang indefinitely), no retry (data loss on transient failures), no auth (assumes trusted network)
components.priority: HIGH - timeout blocks production, MEDIUM - retry acceptable for MVP, LOW - auth only needed for public deployment

components.currentBehavior: Receives TurnLearningRequest, validates via Pydantic, delegates to insert_mapping_record, returns HTTP 201 or 500
components.desiredBehavior: Add rate limiting, sanitize error messages (don't expose internal details in 500 responses)
components.gap: No rate limiting (DoS vulnerability), error details exposed in HTTP 500 (info disclosure)
components.priority: MEDIUM - not critical for internal deployment, required for production

components.currentBehavior: Orchestrates learning pipeline: normalize_pattern, track_usage, calculate_quality, assemble record, insert to DB
components.desiredBehavior: Add duplicate detection (UPSERT or UNIQUE constraint), complete metadata extraction (recentFiles, activityCategory)
components.gap: recordId not guaranteed unique (risk of duplicates), recentFiles empty (TODO comment line 269), activityCategory not extracted from context
components.priority: HIGH - duplicate detection blocks production, LOW - metadata completion is iterative improvement

components.currentBehavior: Extracts abstract pattern using regex (file paths -> {file0}, numbers -> {num0})
components.desiredBehavior: Current heuristic is acceptable for MVP, can iterate to semantic embeddings later
components.gap: Limited to file paths and numbers (no semantic understanding), but this is acceptable for MVP
components.priority: LOW - acceptable for MVP, iterate based on data

components.currentBehavior: Heuristic substring matching to detect impulse usage (file paths, memo snippets, activity IDs in response text)
components.desiredBehavior: Improve accuracy by parsing tool calls or using semantic embeddings
components.gap: False positives (path mentioned but not used) and false negatives (used but not mentioned) affect quality scores
components.priority: LOW - acceptable for MVP, iterate to tool-call parsing or embeddings

components.currentBehavior: Fixed formula: base_score (0.6 success / 0.3 failure) + utilization_bonus (0.4 if any impulse used / 0.0 none used)
components.desiredBehavior: Current formula is reasonable for MVP, can iterate to ML model later
components.gap: Binary utilization (doesn't reward using more impulses), equal weight for all impulses
components.priority: LOW - acceptable for MVP, iterate based on data

components.currentBehavior: Singleton connection, no retry on failure, no connection pooling
components.desiredBehavior: Add connection health checks, retry logic, and optionally connection pooling
components.gap: Single connection bottleneck (scalability), no retry (connection failures fatal), no health checks
components.priority: HIGH - connection health checks and retry block production, MEDIUM - connection pooling for scale

dataFlow.summary: Turn Start → Initialize Buffer → Capture Intent → Capture Impulses → Turn End → Flush → HTTP POST → Validate → Process (normalize, track, calculate) → Assemble Record → Insert SurrealDB → Return Response

critical.impact: Data corruption possible with concurrent turns
critical.recommendation: Use composite key (sessionID:turnNumber) or add mutex per sessionID

critical.impact: Client can hang indefinitely on network issues
critical.recommendation: Add AbortController with 30s timeout in client, 60s timeout in server

critical.impact: Same turn can be recorded multiple times, corrupting metrics
critical.recommendation: Use UPSERT instead of CREATE or add UNIQUE constraint on recordId

critical.impact: Database connection failure disables entire learning system
critical.recommendation: Add connection health checks and retry logic in SurrealDB client

important.issue: Silent failures - incomplete buffers deleted without logging
important.impact: Reduced learning effectiveness, no visibility into systematic issues
important.recommendation: Log incomplete buffer deletions with context, emit metrics for monitoring
Add rate limiting middleware (acceptable to skip for internal deployment)

important.issue: Error details exposed in HTTP 500 responses
important.recommendation: Return generic error messages, log details server-side only

iterative.issue: Incomplete metadata (recentFiles empty, activityCategory not extracted)
iterative.recommendation: Extract recentFiles from session context, pass activityCategory from activity system
Iterate to tool-call parsing or semantic embeddings based on data
Implement connection pool or per-worker connections
